title: 3-D level classifier
summary: A 3-D classifier built from the volume's type: MONAI's networks with spatial_dims 3 (planned).
does: Planned: a level head over a 3-D stem, built from the incoming type, spatial_dims 3, in_channels from sizes.C and out_channels from classes. MONAI's DenseNet121, SEResNet50 and SEResNext50, which tools/train_blocks.py builds with spatial_dims 2 today, take spatial_dims 3 as well. No trainer reads volumes yet.

outputs.name: model
outputs.what: The 3-D network, shaped by the volumes it will read.

params.name: architecture
params.what: the MONAI network, built with spatial_dims 3

nondeterminism: The new head starts from a random draw made under its trainer's seed, so the network repeats only with that seed.

generic.why: Planned for volumes only: frames have the 2-D classifier, and a clip would need a time axis the stem does not take.

resolve: a 3-D {family} whose stem takes {sizes.C} channel(s) of {sizes.D} x {sizes.H} x {sizes.W}; head of {classes}
